title: findings.v1
description: Findings artifact: one document per analyzed target. A package with a lib and a bin compiles twice under one crate name and writes one document each; `target` is what tells them apart, so `crate` is not a primary key. Additive-only within v1; consumers must tolerate unknown fields. reconverge-artifacts::findings is the Rust binding; fixtures/findings/ are the API tests.

target.description: The compiled target's crate types, as cargo spells them (`lib`, `bin`, `proc-macro`). Added in 0.5.0; absent only in a document written before it.

coverage.description: What the analysis could and could not read across this whole target. A property of the run rather than of a finding, so it is present on a clean document too -- which is the case it exists for: a kernel whose divergent barrier is spelled in `asm!` produces no finding to hang a note on. Added in 0.5.0.

opaque_statements.description: Statements the engine could not model (`asm!`, unmodeled intrinsics).

opaque_functions.description: Analyzed functions carrying at least one opaque statement.
